text: The door was opened carefully. <break time="0.8s" /> On the chain. <break time="0.8s" /> And inside the bright hall. <break time="0.8s" /> All the servants stood huddled together. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a flock of frightened sheep. <break time="0.8s" /> At the sight of Utterson. <break time="0.8s" /> The housemaid burst into tears. <break time="0.8s" /> While the cook cried out. <break time="0.8s" /> Bless God, it is Mister Utterson. <break time="0.8s" /> Poole took a candle. <break time="0.8s" /> And led the lawyer through the garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the laboratory. <break time="0.8s" /> Where a flight of stairs. <break time="0.8s" /> Led up to the cabinet door. <break time="0.8s" /> Come as quietly as you can, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> Whispered Poole. <break time="0.8s" /> And if by any chance he asks you in do not go. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he climbed the steps. <break time="0.8s" /> And knocked with an unsteady hand. <break time="0.8s" /> Calling out. <break time="0.8s" /> Mister Utterson, sir, asking to see you. <break time="0.8s" /> A voice from inside answered. <break time="0.8s" /> In a complaining tone. <break time="0.8s" /> Tell him I cannot see anyone. <break time="0.8s" /> And Poole led the lawyer back to the kitchen. <break time="0.8s" /> Sir said Poole. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking him in the eye. <break time="0.8s" /> Was that my masters voice. <break time="0.8s" /> And Utterson. <break time="0.8s" /> Turning very pale. <break time="0.8s" /> Answered that it seemed much changed. <break time="0.8s" /> Changed Have I been twenty years in this mans house. <break time="0.8s" /> To be fooled about his voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Poole. <break time="0.8s" /> His voice trembling with emotion. <break time="0.8s" /> No, sir. <break time="0.8s" /> My master was done away with eight days ago. <break time="0.8s" /> When we heard him cry out. <break time="0.8s" /> Upon the name of God.
